title: Streamtrainfit
_note_name: productName is derived from serviceId+creative+nid → cc-dynamic-streamtrainfit-template-download-nid-gcomp (see references/naming-convention.md). Set productName only to override.
_note_brand: Extract these from the product's LIVE site via Claude-in-Chrome (SPAs won't web_fetch). theme=dark|light; primary=CTA colour; fonts from the site + a matching Google Fonts URL; logoSvg = inline logo.
_note_footer: The /xhosp page is PROXIED onto the product's own domain, so its footer must read as the product site's own footer — same company, same contact, same legal links. HARVEST every field below from the live product footer; do NOT copy the reference /xhosp page, which shows the PARENT company (a cc-qa hard FAIL) and the wrong merchant of record. legalLinks hrefs must be SITE-RELATIVE paths ('/faq', '/legal/<id>') because the page is served from the product's domain — absolute URLs are a domain-preservation violation and verify.mjs fails them. The only exception is a policy hosted on a different subdomain (e.g. portal.<product>.com), which has to stay absolute.

copy.blurb: Streamtrainfit is your all-in-one platform for expertly crafted fitness, yoga, and mindfulness programs designed for modern life.
